theory.title: Talking about your family
theory.explanation: Para presentar a una persona de tu familia usamos This is my + familiar: This is my mother. Para hablar de un hombre o niño usamos he; para una mujer o niña usamos she. Para decir que tienes un familiar usamos I have a + familiar. My significa «mi». Who is this? pregunta quién es la persona.
theory.tip: En mother, father y brother, TH es sonora: coloca suavemente la punta de la lengua entre los dientes y deja vibrar la voz. No es exactamente la z castellana. La H de he y have es una aspiración suave, nunca una jota española.

reading.english: Maya: Hello. I am at school. This is my family photo. Teacher: Who is this? Maya: This is my mother, Anna. This is my father, Ben. This is my sister, Lily, and this is my brother, Tom. I have a baby brother too. This is Leo. This is my grandmother and this is my grandfather. My family is big.

blocks.title: Meet the family
blocks.content: Family significa familia. Es el conjunto de personas de tu familia.

blocks.title: Mother and father
blocks.content: Mother significa madre y father significa padre.
blocks.example: This is my mother. / This is my father.

blocks.title: Sister and brother
blocks.content: Sister significa hermana y brother significa hermano.
blocks.example: This is my sister. / This is my brother.

blocks.title: Baby
blocks.content: Baby significa bebé. Puede acompañar a otra palabra familiar.
blocks.example: a baby brother — un hermano bebé

blocks.title: Grandparents
blocks.content: Grandmother significa abuela y grandfather significa abuelo.

blocks.title: Daughter and son
blocks.content: Daughter significa hija y son significa hijo.
blocks.example: She is my daughter. / He is my son.

blocks.title: Parents and children
blocks.content: Parents significa padres; children significa hijos o niños.

blocks.title: The word MY
blocks.content: My significa mi y aparece antes de un familiar.

blocks.title: THIS IS, HE and SHE
blocks.content: This is presenta a una persona. He se refiere a un hombre o niño; she, a una mujer o niña.
blocks.example: This is my father. He is my father. She is my mother.

blocks.title: I HAVE and WHO
blocks.content: I have significa tengo. Who is this? pregunta quién es la persona de una foto.
blocks.example: I have a sister. / Who is this?
